titre: Fried Rice with Lobster, Chicken or Beef
technique_de_realisation: Heat a large skillet or electric frying pan. Pour in oil.
Break in egg and stir to cook.
Add chopped onion, celery and green peppers. Sauté about 5 minutes or until tender.
Drain mushrooms and add to skillet with salt and pepper.
Pour in cooked rice. Add oil if necessary. Pour on soya sauce mixing until brown.
When well mixed and fried, add the cup of meat.
Serve at once with any sweet & sour recipe or alone.
